title: Tomorrow's Lanterns
narration: The group calmly postpones the festival. The clues, lens, and repair plan are kept ready, and everyone leaves with credit for helping.

dialogue.text: Tomorrow will have wind and light enough for another try.

ending.headline: A Plan for Tomorrow
ending.summary: The festival is responsibly postponed. Everything learned today is preserved, and no one is blamed or left unsafe.

objectiveNotes.text: The search knowledge is saved, including the recovered lens when found.
Any completed repair is protected; remaining work is written into tomorrow's plan.
Everyone is safe, whether they crossed or waited on the village side.

ending.reflection: Choosing to wait can be wise and kind.
